callText: Adult male, fall with a deep leg wound, heavy bleeding

caller.voice: His co-worker, frightened and talking fast, in casual Singapore English. He knows only what he has seen: his co-worker is 38 and fell about 2 m from the painting platform at the void deck, landing on his left leg on the edge of a metal paint tray. The cut is deep, the blood keeps coming out, and the leg looks bent. He didn't hit his head.

answers.location: Blk 6xx Punggol Field, at the void deck. Ground floor, near the lift lobby.
answers.whatHappened: My co-worker, 38. We painting at the void deck, he fall down from the platform, about 2 metres. He land on his left leg, on the metal paint tray. Got a very deep cut, the blood keep coming out. His head never hit.
answers.conscious: Conscious, he can talk, but he look very pale.
answers.icAndMeds: OK, I get his IC ready. His medicine I don't know leh.
answers.criticalInjuries: His leg got a big cut, the blood keep coming out, and the leg look bent.

patient.name: Lee Wei Jie
patient.voice: In pain and frightened, pale, speaks in full sentences.
patient.chiefComplaint: I fell from the platform. My left leg very pain, the blood won't stop.

lines.feelingNow: A bit better. Still feel weak, and my leg very pain.
lines.fall: Yes, I fell from the platform, about 2 metres. I landed on my left leg.
lines.hitHead: No, I never hit my head.
lines.lungHistory: No, no asthma, no lung problem.
lines.verbal: Lee Wei Jie. I'm at the void deck, in Punggol.
lines.motor: OK, both arms up, like this.
lines.position: Let me sit here against the pillar. Don't move my leg.
lines.bpScreen: No shunt, no fistula. Never had operation.
lines.ic: My IC is in my pocket, here.

scene.description: Void deck, blood on the floor

approach.bleeding: Yes: heavy bleeding from a deep cut on the left lower leg.

spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and weak

rbs.findings: Deep cut and deformity of the left lower leg, bleeding controlled; no other injuries

limb.injury: Left lower leg, deformed, with a deep cut
limb.distalPulse: Distal pulse present in the left foot.
limb.immobilise: Buddy splints the left leg as instructed.

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, breath sounds clear

position.choice: Sitting on the floor against the pillar
